processing.title: Processing
processing.body: Analysis runs in the background — you can leave this page and we'll notify you when it's ready.
processing.progressSaved: Your progress is saved — retry continues from there.
processing.notAnalyzed: This video hasn't been analyzed yet.
processing.waitingSource: Waiting for the video to finish uploading or downloading…

workspace.placeholder: Video, tactical map and timeline arrive with the sync engine (M1-FE-08 – M1-FE-12).
workspace.notReady: Results aren't ready yet — the analysis is still running or hasn't started.
workspace.pitchDegraded: Pitch quality is low in parts of this match, so some map positions are hidden.
workspace.pitchUnavailable: The pitch couldn't be mapped for this match: boxes are shown on the video, but the tactical map is empty.
workspace.mapPitchFailed: Couldn't start pitch mapping. Try again.

player.approximateHint: This browser can't report exact video frames; overlays may be 1–4 frames off.

exports.title: Exports
exports.empty: No exports yet. Exports from any match appear here.
exports.deleteConfirm: Delete {{file}}? The file is removed for everyone in your organization.

dialog.title: Export
dialog.rangeHint: Times as mm:ss on the match video.
dialog.rangeInvalid: Enter a start before the end, inside the video.
dialog.noMap: No tactical map for this analysis (pitch not calibrated).
dialog.watermark: Free plan exports include a watermark.
dialog.dataHint: Tracking rows with pitch positions, each flagged with its camera shot and whether it was interpolated, plus the match stats and passes.

corrections.busy: Another job is running for this video.
corrections.noAnalysis: There's no finished analysis for this video yet.

teams.title: Confirm teams
teams.intro: We grouped players by kit. Name each team and choose how it appears on the video and map.
teams.introManual: Help us separate the teams by example.
teams.noSamples: No player samples for this team.
teams.name: Team name
teams.colorsTooClose: The two colors are very similar — pick colors that are easier to tell apart.
teams.noTeams: Teams are available once the analysis has finished.

manual.hint: Click at least 2 players from each team (up to 20). Click again to cycle: Team 1 → Team 2 → none.
manual.keyboard: Keyboard: Tab to a player, then press 1 or 2 to assign it, 0 to clear.
manual.need: Pick at least 2 players for each team.
manual.note: Re-running team detection re-analyzes the video and takes a few minutes.
manual.unavailable: Manual picking isn't available for this analysis. Re-analyze the video to use it.

teams.attackAuto: Guessed from where the goalkeepers stand — check it.
teams.attackUnknown: Not detected — pick the side this team attacks.
teams.keyRolesHelp: Detected on their own; fix any that went to the wrong team.
teams.noKeyRoles: No goalkeepers or referees were detected.

calibrate.title: Calibrate pitch
calibrate.intro: Pick a frame where pitch lines are clearly visible, then match at least 4 points on the frame to the pitch diagram.
calibrate.stage: Video frame at {{time}}. Click to place the selected landmark. Keyboard: Enter places it in the centre; arrow keys move the selected point (Shift: 10 px).
calibrate.stepSelect: Select a landmark on the pitch diagram.
calibrate.stepPlace: Now click the matching spot on the frame for “{{name}}”.
calibrate.preview: Preview pitch lines on the frame
calibrate.collinear: Some points are nearly on one straight line. Spread them out (e.g. the corners of a penalty box) so the pitch can be mapped.
calibrate.cleared: Points cleared because the frame changed.
calibrate.scopeHelpShot: Replaces the pitch mapping for the camera shot that contains this frame.
calibrate.scopeHelpVideo: Also fills other shots whose automatic mapping is missing or weak. This is approximate: broadcast cameras pan and zoom, so one set of points only fits similar views.
calibrate.activeJob: A job is running for this video — wait for it to finish before calibrating.
calibrate.readOnly: Only editors can calibrate the pitch.

reason.frame_ms: All points must be placed on the same frame.
reason.duplicate_landmark: Each pitch landmark can be used only once.
reason.collinear: The points are (nearly) on one straight line, so the pitch couldn't be mapped. Spread them out and try again.
reason.not_analysed_shot: This frame isn't in an analysed wide shot. Pick a frame from a wide camera view.

frameError.no_video: The video isn't prepared yet, so frames can't be shown.
frameError.out_of_range: This time is past the end of the video.
frameError.generic: Couldn't load this frame. Try again in a moment.

landmark.l_box_front_garea_far: Left box edge level with goal area (top, not painted)
landmark.l_box_front_garea_near: Left box edge level with goal area (bottom, not painted)
landmark.r_box_front_garea_far: Right box edge level with goal area (top, not painted)
landmark.r_box_front_garea_near: Right box edge level with goal area (bottom, not painted)

stats.title: Match stats
stats.coverage: Tactical data for {{pct}}% of match time
stats.possessionHint: Share of the time a team had the ball (a player within 2.5 m for ≥ 0.4 s, and its passes in flight), on the main camera only.
stats.passesHint: Inferred from who has the ball: to a teammate = completed, to the other team = lost. Only passes seen on the main camera.
stats.error: Stats couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.
stats.unavailable: This analysis predates match stats. Re-analyse the video (or “Map the pitch automatically”) to get them.
stats.distanceHint: Measured only while players are on the main camera with a usable pitch map.
stats.intensityHint: Metres per observed player-minute. A whole match is usually 100–130; highlight reels run higher.
stats.sprintsHint: Runs above 25.2 km/h held for at least 1 second.
stats.zonesHint: Share of distance walking (< 7.2 km/h), jogging, running and sprinting (≥ 25.2 km/h).
stats.note: Players are only measured while visible on the main camera; one player can appear as several tracks until player identities arrive.
stats.possessionOverTime: Possession over time (click a minute to watch it)

heatmaps.note: Built from {{time}} of observed positions (main camera, usable pitch map).
heatmaps.empty: No positions for this selection yet — the pitch may not be mapped for this match.

passing.mapLabel: Pass map: {{count}} passes on the pitch
passing.empty: No passes seen for this team yet.
passing.note: Passes are inferred from the ball and the players on the main camera. The pass network between players needs player identities across shots and arrives with player recognition.

data.summary: Raw tracking data · schema pitchvision.data/v1 · {{frames}} frames · {{duration}}
data.tracking: Every tracked player, goalkeeper, referee and the ball: pitch position (metres), box on the video, confidence.
data.flags: Each row says which camera shot it comes from (positions exist on the main camera only) and whether it was estimated by interpolation.
data.stats: Team and per-track stats, possession and passes, exactly as shown in this analysis; full-match distances are marked as estimates.
